mapping.notes: Mapping for a research baseline, not proof of traversability. free_space remains ignored because official mapping also treats it as void and its meaning has not been verified. Sky, ego and image borders are ignored. IGNORE is not a learned unknown-object class.

grouping.limitation: Timestamp-run heuristics, not verified recording/session IDs; scene leakage cannot be ruled out.

ignore_policy: 255 excluded from loss/metrics, not trained as an unknown class
